Project Overview The GHSD America First Palladium Sole Source Award supports country-led efforts to strengthen health systems, advance global health security, and sustain essential health services in alignment with the America First Global Health Strategy. Leveraging Palladium's expertise in health systems strengthening, digital transformation, and data use, the project will strengthen governance, service delivery, and decision-making through integrated and interoperable systems across priority health programs. The award also supports stronger health financing, public financial management, and accountability mechanisms to promote resilient, efficient, and country-owned health systems. Duration and Funding This is a fixed-term, project-funded position with an initial term of 12 months (through September 2027). Employment is contingent upon the availability of funding, with the potential for extension based on project requirements and funding availability. Location This role is based in Palladium's Addis Ababa, Ethiopia office, with periodic travel within Ethiopia to project sites and regional offices. Applicants must have authorization to work in Ethiopia, as visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Position Summary The Digital Health (DH) Advisor - EMR, Interoperability, and Health Systems Specialist provides technical leadership and implementation support to strengthen digital health systems that improve service delivery, health system performance, and data-driven decision-making. The role will work closely with government institutions, health facilities, laboratories, Emergency Operations Centers (EOCs), insurers, and development partners to advance digital transformation initiatives that promote efficient service delivery, timely public health action, and sustainable country ownership. Support the operationalization of Emergency Operations Centers (EOCs) and digital emergency management systems. Support digital supply chain and logistics systems that improve commodity visibility, forecasting, and inventory management. Support digital health financing and insurance systems, including claims management, provider payment, and reimbursement platforms. Develop dashboards, analytics, and decision-support tools to improve program performance and resource allocation. Provide technical assistance, capacity strengthening, and stakeholder coordination to support sustainable digital health system adoption.
